template: Open {{v1}} . If you see a sign-in page, log in with username '{{v2}}' and the password given as the literal text {{v3}} — type exactly those characters into the password field and the real password will be filled in automatically as you type; do not guess or substitute any other password. If Grafana prompts you to change your password or shows a welcome tour, skip or dismiss it. Then find and open the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (use dashboard search if helpful) and report the exact titles of all panels shown on that dashboard, exactly as they appear on the page.
